notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{G}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {6}{U}{U}{U}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{G}.
Repeat.
